name: Rohgah
overview: Rohgah is a male figure from the tribe of Asher, identified in Scripture as the son of Shomer. His mention is brief and specific, primarily noted for his paternal relationship. There are no additional details or notes about his life or deeds in the biblical record.
namesAndTitles: The name Rohgah appears only once in Scripture, specifically in 1 Chronicles 7:34. No meaning or special significance of the name is provided, so it is understood simply as a proper name without additional revealed meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Rohgah is explicitly recorded as the son of Shomer, establishing his immediate family connection. Beyond this paternal link, Scripture does not provide further information about his family or descendants.
scriptureSignificance: Though Rohgah's mention in Scripture is brief, his inclusion in the genealogical record of the tribe of Asher serves to preserve the lineage and heritage of God's chosen people. His identification as the son of Shomer situates him within the broader narrative of Israel's tribal history, underscoring the faithfulness of God in maintaining His covenant through successive generations.
